top_choice_rationale: Trapped-ion quantum logic unites a foundational architecture with decades of reproducible high-fidelity experimental control of complex coherent quantum dynamics. Its prize-worthy achievement is already mature independently of any unresolved prospect of scalable quantum computing, provided the citation remains narrow and attribution to the experimental representative withstands priority review.
recusal_note: No direct conflict is apparent for the proposed trapped-ion laureates. I work in superconducting-circuit quantum technology and direct WACQT, so I disclose general professional proximity to quantum-information research, but the supplied evidence gives no direct institutional or collaborative connection to the nominees.
